purpose: Compare the terminal cross-sectional Ccl2 time responses for the supplied groups in lung and serum. Produce two aligned individual panels with separate units, every observation and source-consistent means/SEMs.
mechanism: exact-time mean/SEM anchors, separate compartment units, terminal raw observations
expected_benefit: Lung and serum occupy identical physical data rectangles with identical time ticks and class decoding; separate unit labels and numeric ranges are explicit. Distinct open/filled mean markers help near-coincident group means.
observed_tradeoff: The first serum scale was excessively empty. Pass 2 uses 0–420; pass 3 extends its lower display bound to −10 to keep the lowest positive circle complete. All concentrations remain positive. Compact raw columns can overlap in near-equal observations; no source row is dropped or connected across times.
record_timing: Purpose, roles, actual burden and concrete geometry were planned in create-intent.json, initial spec.json and agent working notes before first rendering; this durable summary was consolidated after bounded image review.
